reason: The native launchers do not yet copy a live profile's SQLite databases and sidecars into a temporary profile before attaching. The shared JavaScript CLI can perform this operation when installed alongside them.
The native packages do not yet host the authenticated extension relay or install and manage its browser extension. The shared JavaScript CLI exposes the extension attach command.
The Rust package has no hand-started reference capture and comparison harness for browser fingerprint measurement.
The native engine adapters can read trace bundles but do not yet instrument navigation, DOM mutations, and network events to write them.
